purpose: Primary-source identification of six funds fixed before performance inspection. No fund selected from performance.
scope_notes: Fund inception is the start of live fund history, not the earlier hypothetical index backtest.
ETF total-return histories test these implemented index strategies, including historical rule changes. They do not validate a new custom stock-selection rule.
Custom rules can differ in universe, return window, risk estimator, selection count, weighting, turnover, review dates, execution and corporate-action handling.
None of these six underlying indexes promises constant realized portfolio volatility. Any common cash or volatility overlay is a separate research rule.
Fund expenses and tracking effects already affect observed fund prices/NAV. Do not deduct the published expense ratio a second time.
This is a targeted material-change review, not an exhaustive reconstruction of every historical index rule.

funds.name: Invesco S&P 500 Momentum ETF
funds.signal: Full 12-month local price change ending one month before the rebalance reference date, divided by daily price-return standard deviation over that same window. Nine-month fallback when 12-month history is unavailable.
funds.timing_example: March rebalance uses February month-end reference; the signal compares January month-end with January month-end one year earlier. This is not the usual 11-month months-2-to-12 signal.
funds.selection: Highest-scoring quintile, approximately 100 stocks; count can vary with eligibility and corporate events. Not the separate S&P 500 Momentum Top 50 index.
funds.score: Cross-sectional risk-adjusted momentum z-score, clipped at +/-3. Positive z maps to 1+z; negative z maps to 1/(1-z).
funds.weighting: Float-adjusted market capitalization multiplied by momentum score, normalized subject to concentration limits. Current methodology applies the lower of 9% at company level and three times the security capitalization weight in the index.
funds.rebalance: Semiannual: after the third Friday close in March and September. Reference dates are the last business days of February and August.

material_changes.change: 9% concentration cap changed from security to company level.

sources.supports: Fund identity, index, inception.
Pages 7-10 selection/weights/reviews; Appendix A exact lookback; Appendix B score; Appendix D cap change.

funds.name: iShares MSCI USA Momentum Factor ETF
funds.index: MSCI USA Momentum SR Variant Index
funds.universe: MSCI USA large- and mid-cap stocks
funds.signal: Six- and twelve-month local price changes, each excluding the latest month, less the local risk-free rate. Each is divided by annualized standard deviation of three years of weekly local price returns.
funds.score: Standardize the two horizon signals, combine their z-scores equally, standardize again, clip the combined z-score at +/-3, then transform to a positive momentum score.
funds.selection: Targets 125 securities. Iterative replacements favor higher momentum while restricting one-way turnover to 30% per review; it is not an unconstrained fresh top-125 portfolio every quarter.
funds.weighting: Parent-index market-cap weight multiplied by momentum score. Issuer cap 5%, plus group concentration rules: weights above 4.5% aggregate to at most 22.5% at review. Between reviews, a 25% aggregate breach for groups above 5% triggers recapping.
funds.rebalance: February, May, August and November reviews, plus conditional reviews and concentration recapping specified by the methodology.

material_changes.change: Fund switched from MSCI USA Momentum Index to MSCI USA Momentum SR Variant Index. Prospectus splice ends the previous index on 2020-11-22.
Removed staggered multi-day implementation; changed semiannual reviews to quarterly; revised selection/weights and diversification rules.

funds.name: Invesco S&P 500 Low Volatility ETF
funds.selection: 100 stocks with the lowest realized volatility over the prior 12 months.
funds.weighting: Inverse individual-stock volatility. No sector-neutrality constraint. This is not covariance-based minimum portfolio variance.
funds.rebalance: Quarterly in February, May, August and November.

material_changes.change: Changed spinoff event treatment to temporary inclusion followed by removal after at least one regular trading day.
Dual-listed companies represented once by their primary listing, generally the most liquid.
Index-share reference prices moved from the second Friday to the preceding Wednesday.

funds.name: iShares MSCI USA Min Vol Factor ETF
funds.universe: MSCI USA large- and mid-cap stocks
funds.selection_and_weighting: Optimizes predicted absolute portfolio volatility using the MSCI risk model, subject to turnover, stock-weight, sector, country and factor-exposure constraints. It does not simply select the lowest-volatility stocks.
funds.rebalance: February, May, August and November reviews. Normal one-way turnover limit is 5% per review, subject to documented feasibility relaxations.

material_changes.change: Optimization switched to the Barra Global Equity Model for Long-Term Investors (GEMLTL), without changing the turnover limit.
Semiannual reviews changed to quarterly while preserving the annual turnover budget. Uses the latest available risk-model data; turnover and minimum-weight constraint relaxations alternate.

funds.constraints: Normal bounds include 0.05% minimum stock weight; maximum is the lower of 1.5% and 20 times parent weight. Sector deviations stay within 5 percentage points. Most other risk-factor deviations stay within 0.25 standard deviations. Feasibility relaxations can apply.
funds.reproduction_limit: MSCI supplies a proprietary risk model. The summary does not specify a reproducible sample-covariance estimator.

funds.name: Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF
funds.selection_and_weighting: All S&P 500 companies with target 1/N company weights. Multiple listed share classes divide the company weight in proportion to float-adjusted capitalization; equal company weights do not mean equal ticker weights.
funds.rebalance: After the third Friday close of March, June, September and December. Current reference prices come from the Wednesday before the second Friday; price moves before implementation can produce departures from exact equal weights.

material_changes.change: Fund reorganization from its Guggenheim predecessor. Issuer retains predecessor history; this alone is not an index-rule change.
Reference prices moved from second Friday to preceding Wednesday.

funds.name: iShares MSCI USA Quality Factor ETF
funds.index: MSCI USA Sector Neutral Quality Index
funds.universe: MSCI USA large- and mid-cap stocks
funds.selection_and_weighting: Ranks quality within sectors using high return on equity, low earnings variability and low leverage. Weights selected securities by quality score times parent-index weight, then matches parent sector weights. Issuer cap is 5%.
funds.rebalance: May and November, normally using fundamentals available at April/October month-end.

material_changes.change: Fund switched from MSCI USA Quality Index to MSCI USA Sector Neutral Quality Index. Prospectus splice ends the prior index on 2015-08-31.

Return on equity and debt/equity both became mandatory for a quality score. Missing earnings variability still allows a score from the other two descriptors. Announcement left other methodology aspects unchanged.
